representations.tokens: Unchanged native Sci2 word stem sets, independently reconstructed exactly from source keyword entries; native stopwords only, no regex query removals imported from earlier TI/AB conditions
representations.phrases: Complete semicolon-delimited author keyword entries; NFKC, lower case and collapsed whitespace; internal punctuation, hyphens and words preserved; discard only full-entry matches to recovered stopwords including explicitly listed query expressions; no stemming
representations.phrases_normalized: Decomposition control: identical native Sci2 word normalization and stopwords applied within each source keyword, ordered stem sequence retained as one atomic node; every per-document union of component tokens equals frozen baseline exactly

confounding: Tokens versus literal phrases changes decomposition and normalization. Tokens versus normalized phrases is the controlled boundary comparison. Literal versus normalized phrases assesses normalization within atomic expressions.
weights: Binary document incidence; one cooccurrence per unordered pair per record
pruning: Original native top-thirds extraction and half-up rounding of extraction counts. Recompute tau = mean edge weight times log10(second-stage node count). Preserve recovered unrounded tau for cross-sectional 2023–2024 and nearest integer otherwise. Preserve comparison operators. The ambiguous 2021–2022 approved token >=15 is retained; atomic graphs use a predeclared rounded recomputation with >=.
cross_sectional_2021_2022_note: Frozen token mask uses approved effective >=15. New phrase conditions recompute their own rounded cutoff and retain >= as comparator; not claimed to reproduce an unrecorded historical UI step.
suppress: Delete filtered elements; log isolates and smaller components; detect on largest nonisolated retained component
hide: Detect on full network with all components and isolates; apply same representation-specific suppression mask to display only
levels: L0 first distinct, L1 second, L2 third if returned; FINAL actual last distinct and index reported. No imputed missing levels.
primary_cross_representation_metric: Document-projected ARI on identical UTs. Each distinct original keyword has unit mass: token mode distributes that mass equally among its distinct surviving stems, atomic modes assign it to the keyword node. Filtered units contribute zero mass. A unique maximum selects document community; zero coverage and tied maxima are unassigned. Common eligible UTs across all paired seeds are fixed before computing the primary 30-score distribution; pairwise intersections are sensitivity results.
secondary_cross_representation_metric: ARI on original keyword-expression units only where token constituents all participate and unanimously share one community. Fragmentation and coverage are reported; no ARI on unlike raw node universes.
visuals: Weighted Kamada Kawai cross sections, native GUESS GEM cumulative. Frozen union-mask geometry within each representation; different vocabularies do not imply a shared node canvas. Seed1000 illustrated in Word, every seed and multiplier in offline atlas.
